mainEntity.name: How much does a BMW X3 G01 30i engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A BMW X3 G01 30i engine replacement typically costs £1,500-£4,500 depending on the condition type and engine code. Used engines start from around £1,500, reconditioned units from £1,800, and rebuilt engines with a 12-month warranty from £1,800. Labour for fitting adds approximately £500-£1,000 for an independent specialist.

mainEntity.name: Is the BMW X3 G01 30i B48 engine reliable?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, the B48B20 is generally reliable and capable of 150,000+ miles with proper maintenance. However, coolant system issues, injector seal leaks, and PCV system failure are common at higher mileages. Regular servicing with BMW Longlife-14 approved oil is essential.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine on a BMW X3 G01 30i?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, replacing the engine on a BMW X3 G01 30i is usually worthwhile given strong residual values (£15,000-£35,000). A rebuilt engine with warranty typically costs £1,800-£3,800 versus the cost of a comparable replacement vehicle, making repair the economically sensible choice for most owners.

mainEntity.name: How long does a BMW X3 G01 30i engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical BMW X3 G01 30i engine replacement takes 2-4 working days for a full rebuild, including parts sourcing, fitting, and testing. Supply-only engines can often be dispatched within 1-3 working days, with fitting then scheduled at your chosen specialist.

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between the BMW X3 G01 30i and 20i?

acceptedAnswer.text: The 30i produces 252hp from its 2.0-litre turbo petrol, while the 20i produces 184hp from the same 2.0-litre displacement. Both share the same B48 engine architecture, but the 30i uses a higher state of tune with a different turbocharger and engine management calibration.

mainEntity.name: What engine code is in my BMW X3 G01 30i?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your BMW X3 G01 30i will have one of three engine codes depending on its production year: B48B20 (2017-2024), B48B20A (2017-2020), or B48B20B (2020-2024). Enter your registration above to confirm the exact code fitted to your vehicle.

Over the G01 production run, the 30i badge carried the modular B48 engine family with a clear step up in power and refinement over the outgoing N20.

commonProblems.h2: BMW X3 G01 30i Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The BMW X3 G01 30i is powered by the B48B20 2.0-litre turbo petrol engine - part of BMW's modular B-series family. The B48 is generally reliable and capable of 150,000+ miles with proper maintenance. However, injector seal leaks, coolant system issues, and PCV system failure are the most common failure points. Every rebuilt engine supplied through EnginesMarket includes upgraded components addressing the original failure point, plus a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.h4: Coolant System Failure - Why the BMW X3 G01 30i B48 Suffers Leaks and Overheating
problems.rootCause: The factory plastic coolant expansion tank becomes brittle under repeated thermal cycling, leading to micro-fractures. Combined with thermostat housing degradation and coolant hose connection wear, this causes rapid coolant loss and potential head gasket stress.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace leaking hoses, clamps, and thermostat housing assembly
repairOptions.longevity: Short-term fix; expansion tank often fails next

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Full drain, new expansion tank, water pump, thermostat, and pressure test
repairOptions.longevity: Viable if caught before overheating; prevents further damage

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit, rebuilt unit with upgraded aluminium coolant components, coding, and full fluid flush
repairOptions.longevity: Permanent solution; addresses head gasket risk

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical 2017-2024 BMW X3 G01 30i is worth approximately £15,000-£35,000. Replacement cost is typically small relative to vehicle value, making a rebuilt engine a viable option if needed.
problems.recommendation: If your BMW X3 G01 30i is losing coolant but shows no misfires or white exhaust smoke, a full coolant system overhaul (£550-£850 at a specialist) is highly cost-effective. However, if the temperature gauge has spiked or coolant has contaminated the oil, internal warping is likely occurring. At that stage, a rebuilt engine is the only reliable path.
problems.cta: -> Compare rebuilt B48B20 BMW X3 G01 30i engine prices

problems.h4: Injector Seal Leaks - Why the BMW X3 G01 30i B48 Suffers Fuel Dilution
problems.rootCause: The injector seals can degrade over time, allowing fuel to leak past the seal and into the engine oil. This causes oil dilution, reducing lubrication quality and increasing wear on bearings and timing chain components.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace injector seals, clean injectors, oil and filter change
repairOptions.longevity: Viable if caught early; restores fuel system integrity

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace all injectors, seals, fuel rail check, full fuel system flush
repairOptions.longevity: Recommended if injectors are high-mileage or damaged

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit, rebuilt unit with new injectors, full fuel system calibration
repairOptions.longevity: Required if oil dilution has caused bearing damage

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical BMW X3 G01 30i is worth £15,000-£35,000, so replacement is generally financially viable for owners who plan to keep the car long-term.
problems.recommendation: If you notice the oil level rising between services or a strong fuel smell from the oil filler cap, have the injector seals inspected immediately. A £400-£700 injector seal replacement at a specialist can save the engine. If the oil has been heavily diluted, a full oil flush and bearing inspection are essential.
problems.cta: -> Compare rebuilt B48B20 BMW X3 G01 30i engine prices

problems.h4: PCV System Failure - Why the BMW X3 G01 30i B48 Suffers Oil Consumption and Rough Idle
problems.rootCause: The PCV (Positive Crankcase Ventilation) diaphragm can fail, causing excessive crankcase pressure, oil consumption, and rough idle. In severe cases, it can lead to oil seal failure and increased oil consumption.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace PCV diaphragm, clean throttle body, reset adaptations
repairOptions.longevity: Viable for most failures; restores idle quality

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit, rebuilt unit with new PCV system, full warranty
repairOptions.longevity: Only necessary if PCV failure has caused secondary damage

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical BMW X3 G01 30i is worth £15,000-£35,000, so a PCV repair is almost always cost-effective.
problems.recommendation: PCV failure is common on higher-mileage B48 engines. A £250-£450 repair at a specialist is far cheaper than a full engine rebuild. However, if excessive oil consumption has caused bearing damage, a rebuilt engine may be necessary.
problems.cta: -> Compare rebuilt B48B20 BMW X3 G01 30i engine prices
